description: Table component for list data with selection enhancements, cell change tracking, row dragging and column dragging.

events.description: Emitted when a cell field write is detected.
events.name: cell-change

events.description: Emitted when row click or selection changes toggle selected state.
events.name: selection-row-toggle

events.description: Emitted when single-select constraints conflict with native multi-select behavior.
events.name: selection-single-conflict

exposes.description: Recalculate table column widths and layout.
exposes.name: doLayout

exposes.description: Return the currently selected table rows.
exposes.name: getSelectionRows

exposes.description: Scroll to a position or node.
exposes.name: scrollTo
exposes.type: { (options: ScrollToOptions): void; (xCoord: number, yCoord?: number | undefined): void; }

exposes.description: Set the current highlighted table row.
exposes.name: setCurrentRow

exposes.description: Set the horizontal table scroll position.
exposes.name: setScrollLeft

exposes.description: Set the vertical table scroll position.
exposes.name: setScrollTop

exposes.description: Sort the table by the specified column.
exposes.name: sort

exposes.description: Toggle expansion for the specified row.
exposes.name: toggleRowExpansion

exposes.description: Toggle selection for the specified row.
exposes.name: toggleRowSelection
exposes.type: (row: RowData, selected?: boolean | undefined, ignoreSelectable?: boolean | undefined) => void

props.description: Maximum depth for cell data write tracking.
props.name: cellProxyMaxDepth

props.description: Whether clicking a cell highlights the row and column.
props.name: crossHighlight

props.description: Column index containing the row drag handle.
props.name: rowDragHandleColumnIndex

props.description: Field used as the row key in event callbacks.
props.name: rowKeyField

props.description: Whether clicking a row toggles selection when a selection column exists.
props.name: selectionRowClick

props.description: Whether multi-select mode is limited to one selected row.
props.name: selectionSingle
